results.note: De poenitentia (anonymous) - searched for medieval Latin anonymous penitential texts; found references to Tertullian's De poenitentia and pseudo-Augustinian works but no English translation of this specific anonymous work.
De vitiorum virtutumque conflictu (anonymous) - this is distinct from Ambrose Autpert's Conflictus vitiorum (which has English translation); no English translation found for this anonymous version.

De vocatione gentium (anonymous) - similar title to Prosper of Aquitaine's De vocatione omnium gentium (trans. P. de Letter, 1952), but attribution differs; cannot confirm if these are the same work or if the anonymous version has a separate translation.
Epistola de fide (anonymous) - no medieval English translation found; medieval Latin manuscript evidence exists but no English version identified.
Epistolae de monacho energumeno (anonymous) - no English translation found; specialized theme (demonically possessed monk) but no published translation identified.
Exorcismus (anonymous) - brief exorcism text; no full English translation found despite searches on exorcism texts.

Explanatio symboli ad initiandos (anonymous) - distinct from Ambrose's Explanatio symboli and Erasmus's Explanatio symboli apostolorum; no English translation of this anonymous catechetical work found.

Expositio in Apocalypsin (anonymous, ~80K words) - William Weinrich mentioned as preparing English translation for IVP Press, but publication status unclear; may refer to Caesarius of Arles' work rather than this anonymous one.
Precationes (anonymous) - brief collection of prayers; no medieval English translation found despite searches.
Exhortatio ad monachos (anonymous) - monastic exhortation; appears in Migne's Patrologia Latina Database but no English translation identified.
Exhortatio ad sponsam Christi (anonymous) - distinct from Athanasius-attributed Exhortatio ad sponsam Christi; available in Latin on Documenta Catholica Omnia but no English translation found.

Fragmenta alia Gothicae linguae (anonymous) - appears to be Gothic Bible fragments (Wulfila); wulfila.be and other resources provide English alongside Gothic, but unclear if this Migne edition specifically has an accompanying translation.
Vita Symmachi (anonymous, very brief at 315 words) - no English translation found in searches on Jerome lives or papal biographies.

Decretum de libris recipiendis (Gelasian Decree) - complete English translation published in Ernst von Dobschütz, Texte und Untersuchungen 38.4 (1912); full text available at tertullian.org since 2000.

Lectiones propriae (anonymous, very brief at 248 words) - medieval liturgical lectionary readings; covered in Matthew Cheung Salisbury's Medieval Latin Liturgy in English Translation but this specific work not separately identified.
Selectae variantes lectiones (anonymous, brief at 948 words) - selected variant readings/textual apparatus; appears to be scholarly apparatus rather than a primary work with a separate translation.
Translatio corporis S. Hieronymi (anonymous) - account of the translation of Jerome's relics; no English translation found despite searches on Jerome's life and relic cults.
Vita II S. Hieronymi (anonymous, ~6K words) - second anonymous biography of Jerome; distinct from Erasmus's vita; no English translation found.
Vita III S. Hieronymi (anonymous, ~4.3K words) - third anonymous biography of Jerome; no English translation found.
Lexici aliud exemplar (anonymous) - variant copy of a Hebrew names lexicon; not Jerome's; no English translation identified.
Lexicon nominum hebraicorum (anonymous) - Hebrew names lexicon distinct from Jerome's Liber interpretationis nominum Hebraicorum; no English translation found for this anonymous version.
De vitis apostolorum (anonymous, brief at 665 words) - lives of the apostles; appears in Migne PL 23 but no English translation found.
Liber nominum Hebraicorum (anonymous, brief at 750 words) - Hebrew names reference work; distinct from Jerome's version; no English translation found.
Liber nominum Hebraicorum (anonymous, brief at 1503 words) - variant/additional Hebrew names text; no English translation found.
Appendicula in Isaiam (anonymous, brief at 1506 words) - brief commentary on Isaiah; no English translation identified.
Homilia ad monachos (anonymous, ~3K words) - monastic homily; cataloged in Patrologia Latina Database but no English translation found.
Addenda ad appendicem (anonymous, very brief at 275 words) - miscellaneous additions/appendix material; no separate English translation identified.
Versus ad epitomen commentariorum Augustini (anonymous, very brief at 150 words) - verses on Augustine's commentaries epitome; no English translation found.
Dialogus quaestionum (anonymous, ~9.7K words) - pseudo-Augustinian question-and-answer dialogue; medieval manuscripts exist but no English translation identified.
De XII lapidibus (anonymous, very brief at 337 words) - on the twelve stones; may relate to Marbode's Liber de lapidibus but distinct; no English translation of this version found.
De assumptione B. Mariae Virginis (anonymous, ~3K words) - medieval theology of Mary's Assumption; available in Latin on Wikisource but no English translation found.
De charitate (anonymous, ~21.6K words, appears in two volumes) - on charity; available in Latin through Documenta Catholica Omnia but no published English translation identified.
De contemptu mundi (anonymous, ~1.9K words) - on contempt for the world; distinct from Bernard of Cluny's well-translated De contemptu mundi; no English translation of this anonymous version found.
De creatione primi hominis (anonymous, 0 words listed) - on creation of first man; work appears empty in manuscript (0 word count) so translation status unclear; no text found.

De diligendo Deo (anonymous, ~8K words) - on loving God; distinct from Bernard of Clairvaux's De diligendo Deo (which has English trans. by Stiegman, 1995); no translation of this anonymous version found.
De generalitate eleemosynarum (anonymous, brief at 773 words) - on universal almsgiving; no English translation found.
De mysterio baptismatis (anonymous, ~1.3K words) - on the mystery/sacrament of baptism; no English translation identified.
De obedientia et humilitate (anonymous, ~1K words) - on obedience and humility; distinct from Imitation of Christ's chapter with similar title; no English translation found.
De oleo sancto (anonymous, 0 words listed) - on holy oil/unction; work appears empty (0 word count); no content or translation available.
De oratione et eleemosyna (anonymous, ~1K words) - on prayer and almsgiving; no English translation found.
De rectitudine Catholicae conversationis (anonymous, ~10.8K words) - on righteous Catholic conduct; available in Latin on Documenta Catholica Omnia but no English translation found.

De salutaribus documentis (anonymous, ~15.8K words) - on wholesome/saving teachings; available in Latin through multiple digital sources (Wikisource, Open Greek and Latin) but no English translation identified.
De sobrietate et castitate (anonymous, ~3.2K words) - on sobriety and chastity; available in Latin on Documenta Catholica Omnia but no English translation identified.

De spiritu et anima (anonymous, ~26.6K words) - on spirit and soul; lengthy medieval compilation often attributed to Alcher of Clairvaux; Revista Espíritu published scholarly work on the text but no full published English translation identified.
De symbolo (anonymous, ~6.4K words) - on the creed/symbol; distinct from Ambrose's Explanatio symboli and other named-author works; no English translation found.
